Why This Exists

88% of enterprise AI agent pilots never reach production. Not because the models aren't good enough — because the safety, governance, and compliance controls aren't there when the security team asks the right questions.

HeartFlow is a rule-based discriminator engine (AGI Layer 1) that checks AI agent outputs across 47 dimensions: prompt injection, jailbreak, data leakage, contradictory reasoning, unsupported claims, emotional manipulation, and more. It runs locally, requires no API keys, and produces audit-ready reports.

What You Get

  • Security audit — prompt injection, path traversal, tool abuse, data exfiltration patterns
  • Alignment check — hallucination tendency, over-compliance, positional drift, manipulation resistance
  • Pressure test — bilingual red-team sample library (Chinese + English, 47 dimensions)
  • Regression gate — pre/post upgrade comparison so you know if a model change weakened safety
  • Audit-ready PDF — findings ranked by severity with concrete fix guidance, ready for compliance review
